bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
head=8f374cc9854c12b03a39d6048c8b2242ac5f67ca
base=86dd6e2fb96f5632bafc18b358669e900998586a
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
oldid=sha256:44b7f6c83af3ef1d1cbba4f02caee10b39f63f6ddc2608d897a8386c2eb3a5d5
stage="$HOME/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/opus-8f374cc-stage-20261125"
newtag=create-videobot:opus-8f374cc-stage
rollbacktag=create-videobot:rollback-opus-8f374cc
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$oldid"
test "$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll --format '{{.Names}}' | wc -l)" -eq 1
test ! -e "$stage"
mkdir -p "$stage"/{candidate,live,base,merged}
git cat-file -e "$head^{commit}"
git cat-file -e "$base^{commit}"
git archive "$head" src sql test package.json | tar -xf - -C "$stage/candidate"
git diff --name-only "$base" "$head" -- src sql > "$stage/changed.txt"
test "$(wc -l < "$stage/changed.txt")" -eq 6
conflicts=0
while IFS= read -r f; do
  mkdir -p "$stage/live/$(dirname "$f")" "$stage/base/$(dirname "$f")" "$stage/merged/$(dirname "$f")"
  docker cp "$cid:/opt/videobot/$f" "$stage/live/$f"
  git show "$base:$f" > "$stage/base/$f"
  if cmp -s "$stage/live/$f" "$stage/base/$f"; then
    cp "$stage/candidate/$f" "$stage/merged/$f"
    echo "DIRECT $f"
  elif cmp -s "$stage/live/$f" "$stage/candidate/$f"; then
    cp "$stage/live/$f" "$stage/merged/$f"
    echo "ALREADY $f"
  elif git merge-file -p -L live -L base -L candidate "$stage/live/$f" "$stage/base/$f" "$stage/candidate/$f" > "$stage/merged/$f"; then
    echo "MERGED $f"
    diff -u "$stage/candidate/$f" "$stage/merged/$f" || test "$?" -eq 1
  else
    echo "CONFLICT $f"
    diff -u "$stage/base/$f" "$stage/live/$f" || test "$?" -eq 1
    grep -n -A 18 -B 8 '^<<<<<<<' "$stage/merged/$f" || true
    conflicts=$((conflicts+1))
  fi
done < "$stage/changed.txt"
test "$conflicts" -eq 0 || exit 67
docker tag "$oldid" "$rollbacktag"
printf 'FROM %s\nCOPY merged/src/ /opt/videobot/src/\n' "$rollbacktag" > "$stage/Dockerfile"
docker build --pull=false --network none -t "$newtag" "$stage" > "$stage/build.log" 2>&1 || { tail -n 50 "$stage/build.log"; exit 68; }
while IFS= read -r f; do
  test "$(sha256sum "$stage/merged/$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$(docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint sha256sum "$newtag" "/opt/videobot/$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
done < "$stage/changed.txt"
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node -w /opt/videobot -v "$stage/candidate/test:/opt/videobot/test:ro" "$newtag" --test test/creatorBot.test.mjs test/creatorMigrate.test.mjs test/creatorPollingStartup.test.mjs test/creatorSourceIntegration.test.mjs test/creatorUi.test.mjs test/creatorWizard.test.mjs test/videoRealFfmpeg.test.mjs test/videoInvoiceSales.test.mjs test/paidListingPublisher.test.mjs > "$stage/new.tap" 2>&1 || { tail -n 80 "$stage/new.tap"; exit 69; }
tail -n 12 "$stage/new.tap"
printf 'STAGED_IMAGE='; docker image inspect "$newtag" --format '{{.Id}}'
echo OPUS_STAGE_AND_SELECTED_TESTS_PASS_NO_LIVE_RESTART
